gen-zen-dots-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpande: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded has open-mouthed curves and a modern, businesslike manner. Zen Dots above it is the playful one, a techy display face with generous space around each letter, so a long page of text still moves along smoothly.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Zen Dots has a gadget-friendly, spacious look, with openings that stay generous at every weight. ZCOOL XiaoWei follows with a quiet shift from stem to serif, and if the heading is sized up a little, that gentle texture reads clearly beneath it.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Wide-open, techy letters give Zen Dots a friendly, gadget-like face, with generous room around every shape in the heading. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique answers with rope-like stems.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Zen Dots brings the techy, friendly display energy. Zen Kaku Gothic New has no swelling mid-curve at all, and that smooth, uniform line is the strongest thing this pairing has going for it.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Dots gives headings a friendly, techy sparkle, with plenty of space around each letter shape. And Zen Maru Gothic is the quiet worker, a sans-serif whose bowls never thin at the sides, so reading feels like following a single thread.
gen-zen-dots-ibm-plex-sans: Generous room around every letter makes Zen Dots look techy and friendly at once. If the heading is made small, that spaciousness fades, while IBM Plex Sans keeps a wide channel into every bowl at text sizes.
gen-zen-dots-zilla-slab: Zen Dots is all friendly tech, with generous room around every letter and openings that hold at any weight. Zilla Slab adds sturdy slab-serif footing, and the strongest thing here is how that broad, open build grounds the playful heading.
